system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: seven orthogonal component types as explicit files at fixed mount points in a single workspace: system prompt, tool description, tool implementation, middleware, skill, sub-agent configuration, and long-term memory
system_prompt_style.note: systemprompt.md is a file, but middleware (environment_info, round_and_token_reminder) and skills/memory are composed in; the prompt itself is also rewritten by the Evolve Agent across iterations.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Our seed harness H0 is deliberately minimal: a single shell-execution tool, no middleware, no skills, no sub-agents.
env_context_strategy.note: Code agent explores via shell only in the seed harness.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: middleware/ # context compaction / failover / ralph loop …
context_compaction.note: evolve_agent ships context_compaction middleware with compact_tool_result and sliding_window strategies plus long_tool_output.py; the seed code agent has no middleware.

observation_format.note: evolve_agent additionally ships read_visual_file.tool.yaml, suggesting image reading there.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: agent/nexau_in_memory_tracer.cleaned.json — full step-level trace (messages, tool calls, middleware events)
tool_call_format.note: NexAU tool descriptions are .tool.yaml schemas consumed as tool calls; exact serialization not shown in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Our seed harness H0 is deliberately minimal: a single shell-execution tool, no middleware, no skills, no sub-agents.
tool_count.note: Seed code agent ships only tool_descriptions/run_shell_command.tool.yaml; the evolve_agent has ~18 tool descriptions.

edit_primitive.note: Code agent edits files via shell only; the evolve_agent has apply_patch/replace/write_file tools but those act on the harness workspace, not task repos.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool descriptions are hand-written YAML files; agents/evolve_agent/tools/mcp_client.py provides MCP-sourced tools.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Algorithm 1 composes the three substrates into one iteration: rollout, clean, attribute the prior manifest and revert rejected edits, distill, edit, commit.
loop_primitives.note: Outer AHE loop is a fixed evaluate→analyze→improve pipeline with verification-and-rollback; the inner code agent is a react loop.

planning_granularity.note: write_todos is available to the evolve agent; the seed code agent has no plan object (implicit).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: all three role agents (the Code Agent, the Agent Debugger, and the Evolve Agent) share one base model
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off among three specialised role agents plus a one-shot explore agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A one-shot explore agent (Appendix B.3) runs in parallel with iteration 1 to seed a small number of reusable skills
delegation_mechanism.note: agents/evolve_agent/tools/recall_sub_agent_tool.py provides sub-agent invocation; NexAU exposes sub-agent configuration as a component.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: which runs unattended round after round
human_in_loop.note: evolve_agent ships ask_user.tool.yaml but the loop runs unattended in tmux by default.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: `input/` holds the workspace produced by loop `NNN-1` (just evaluated), `evolve/` holds what loop `NNN` writes
short_term_state.note: Change manifest plus ShortTermMEMORY.md/todos beyond messages; the inner code agent alone is closer to conversation_only.

long_term_memory.note: LongTermMEMORY.md persists across iterations; skills/ is a reusable skill library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: `--experiment <name>` | Resume an existing experiment (pass the directory name under `experiments/`)

self_verification.note: Harness runs harbor verifiers each iteration and feeds results into Agent Debugger analysis; Agent Debugger is an LLM analysis over own traces.

retry_policy.note: k≥2 rollouts per task and up to max_iterations (default 100) evolution rounds; per-task retries capped by k.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each logical edit becomes one commit on the workspace’s git history, which yields file-level diffs and rollback granularity for free.

termination_condition.note: Outer loop: target_pass_rate / max_iterations. Inner agent: complete_task tool and a step budget ('AHE’s step budget and per-task timeout were fitted to GPT-5.4 high').

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `experiment_timeout_minutes` | Total wall-clock budget for the experiment (0 = unlimited)
cost_controls.note: Token accounting is reported (tokens/trial) and context compaction limits tokens via token_threshold trigger; no monetary cap found in evidence.

timeouts.note: Also 'tunable shell timeout' per command (Figure 1) and per-task timeout extended to 1 hour.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: AHE runs every rollout inside an E2B sandbox.
execution_isolation.note: E2B sandboxes spawned from prebuilt templates; SaaS (default) or self-hosted cluster.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Every rollout runs inside an E2B sandbox spawned from a prebuilt template that already has `uv` and the NexAU/harbor venv at `/opt/nexau-venv`.
filesystem_access.note: Code agent has unrestricted shell access within the sandbox; the Evolve Agent is scoped ('writes only inside the harness workspace').

network_policy.note: No network restriction option documented; sandboxes pull packages and the evolve agent does web search/fetch.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the Evolve Agent writes only inside the harness workspace, while the runs directory, tracer, verifier, and LLM configuration are read-only
permission_model.note: Path-scoped write restriction for the Evolve Agent; the inner code agent's shell actions are executed without per-call authorisation.

tracing.evidence_quote: `agent/nexau_in_memory_tracer.cleaned.json` — full step-level trace (messages, tool calls, middleware events)
tracing.note: Optional LANGFUSE_* observability hooks also shipped.

replayability.evidence_quote: `--skip-eval` | Skip evaluation and reuse existing rollouts (for debugging)
replayability.note: Stored rollouts can be reused/analyzed; no bit-for-bit replay claim.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `harbor` runs the current `code_agent` over the dataset inside isolated E2B sandboxes.
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2 / harbor datasets is wired into evolve.py's loop; harbor itself is a dependency.

guardrails.evidence_quote: These restrictions block the shortcuts an unconstrained self-modifier would take, such as disabling the verifier, swapping the model, or raising the reasoning budget
guardrails.note: Write-scope restrictions and non-deletable seed prompt; paper notes 'it does not provide a complete guardrail stack'.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an open **observability system** for automatically evolving the harness around a coding agent
target_domain.note: Evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2 and SWE-bench-verified; evolve_agent has web search tools but web is not a task domain.

open_source.evidence_quote: The current release ships a *partially* open-sourced Agent Debugger; due to company strategy, it cannot be fully open-sourced at this time.
open_source.note: MIT licence on the repo but a core component is not fully open.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we re-evaluate the Code Agent on five alternate bases: GPT-5.4 [26] at medium and xhigh reasoning, qwen-3.6-plus [38, 44], gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview [8], and deepseek-v4-flash [6].

first_release_date.note: No tags in evidence; basis is the '[2026-04] 🎉 Framework released' / arXiv release date.

pinned_version.note: No release tag reported; untagged main commit.
